description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of question types across three difficulty levels: easy, medium, and hard. The chart consists of three separate pie charts, one for each difficulty level, each containing between three and four slices. In the “easy” chart, slices represent “CoT” (light green, 40.6%), “N+K+” (dark green, 45.9%), “N-K+” (yellow, 10.1%), and “N+K-” (orange, 3.3%). The “medium” chart shows “CoT” (light green, 44.6%), “N+K+” (dark green, 44.3%), “N-K+” (yellow, 7.2%), and “N+K-” (orange, 3.9%). The “hard” chart displays “N+K+” (dark green, 36.2%), “N-K+” (yellow, 20.1%), “N+K-” (orange, 7.0%), and “N-K-” (red, 36.8%). Each slice within the charts is labeled with its corresponding category and percentage, and no slices are visually emphasized or offset. The slices in each chart appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from largest to smallest proportion.
